description: VYBE Music v4.2.0 - Complete YouTube Playlist Import (Zero Missing Songs), Instant Playback for Imported Songs, Protected Playlist Sync, Total Listening Hours & Installed Days in Library, and Spotify Matching Fallback.

announcement.title: Welcome To VYBE Music v4.2.0
announcement.message: Welcome to VYBE Music v4.2.0! Featuring complete YouTube playlist imports with all songs included, instant playback for imported songs, dynamic radio/mix pagination, total listening hours & installed days right in your library, and enhanced Spotify search accuracy.

changelog.title: Complete YouTube Playlist Import & Zero Missing Songs
items: Full Pagination on Import: All playlist tracks across all pages are imported without truncating or missing songs
YouTube Radio & Mix Continuations: Added seamless /next continuation support so dynamic queues and mixes load completely
Direct Library Navigation: After import, automatically opens your newly created library playlist with all songs ready to play

changelog.title: Instant Playback for Imported Songs
items: Fixed Playback from Imported Playlists: Resolved media stream resolution and videoId extraction so songs play immediately when tapped
Protected Local Playlists: Prevented playlist wipeouts by skipping destructive clearing on empty remote responses or radio mixes

changelog.title: Listening Stats in Library
items: Replaced Recap: Display total listening hours and days since the app was installed right in your library playlists and mix screens
Quick Access to Insights: Tap the listening stats button to jump straight into detailed listening stats and history

changelog.title: Enhanced Spotify Matching Accuracy
items: Fallback Song Search: Added automatic fallback search without strict song filters so Spotify tracks are never missed during import
